PART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The Allotments of Land depicted in below name and extent in the Advance Tracing No. MAHA/GIK/2022/997 dated 27.02.2023, prepared by the Surveyor - General, situated in the Village Called Wetakedeniya in the Grama Niladhari Division, No. 1058 of Wetakedeniya in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ganga Ihala in Kandy District in Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot zAZ - Kabalakawa Wetakedeniya (1058) - Extent : 0.2529 Hectare North:Lot No.5 of Plan No P.P. Maha 6247, Canal,Kabalakawa claimed by Land Reform Commission; East: Kabalakawa claimed by Land Reform Commission and Kabalakawa claimed by Bhanuka Pilapitiya; South: Lot B, Kabalakawa claimed by Bhanuka Pilapitiya and Kabalakawa claimed by Land Reform Commission ; West : Kabalakawa claimed by Land Reform Commission.

02. Lot zBZ - Kabalakawa Wetakedeniya (1058) - Extent : 0.1012 Hectare North: Kabalakawa claimed by Land Reform Commission and Lot A; East: Kabalakawa claimed by Bhanuka Pilapitiya; South: Kabalakawa claimed by Land Reform Commission and Lot C ; West : Kabalakawa claimed by Land Reform Commission and Kabalakawa claimed by Bhanuka Pilapitiya.
